review_text: Recommended by a good friend, she told us the humble story of this coffee shop and how the owner started his business during the pandemic as a street barista. Ordered KAPE DE LECHE (and loved it!) Must try: Honey Lemon Mindanao coffee beans is a must try!! ☕️ There are no dining area so you can only order by take out. They accept cash and GCASH payments.
Got a great chance to enjoy an amazing cup of coffee made from unique beans by a legend who was one of the pioneers that brought specialty cafes to Davao!☕

A great little coffee shop to grab a coffee and go. It was hot out and I wanted something cold so I ordered the Kape Citrucy. I couldn’t wait to walk home so I could relax snd enjoy it. It was full bodied and refreshing with subtle hints of citrus. Prices were reasonable and the barista was friendly. Give them a try if you are in the area,

It’s like a hole in a wall friendly neighboorhood coffeeshop. Tip: order off the menu blend. I got tiramisu blend. Sadly, they’re out of stock for drip to go coffee. Bartender will help you choose also if you’re at loss what to order. You can park infront of the building. There’s only one table here.

Kape De Leche (less sugar) is a must try. Di naman masyadong halata na nagustuhan ko ang drink nato, I ordered a bigger size lang naman day after I first tasted their coffee. For those commuting just like me, you may ride a Jeepney with a signage Route 8 going to this place. 😁
